title: The passenger across the aisle
logline: The seat across the aisle with someone in it, from behind, a hood up, asleep, invented. The one stranger on the route. The page gives her a stranger to not talk to.

panels.composition: A bus seat across the aisle from behind with a hooded passenger asleep against the window, the aisle's rubber floor, morning light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bus seat across the aisle seen from behind with a hooded passenger asleep against the window, rubber aisle floor, morning light, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: A stranger to not talk to.
